title: After Mark OK: what it covered, Undo, and clearing it
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a technician with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', on the build under test.
  2. An inspection where Mark OK can be pressed at a level and then edited elsewhere; and a scope with nothing left to mark.
custom_steps:
1. Press the action and confirm the row reports what it covered, counted in its own unit (fields at inspection/section level, positions on a field), and offers Undo.
2. Confirm every level beneath the one pressed reports the same, so before and after read at a glance down the page, while Undo appears only on the row that was pressed.
3. Make any next edit in the inspection (a verdict, a value, or a Single/Dual switch) and confirm the report clears and the actions return.
4. On a scope with nothing left to mark, confirm the action renders inert (keeps its place) rather than disappearing.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After the press the row reports what it covered, counted in its own unit (fields at inspection and section level, positions on a field), and offers Undo.
  • Every level beneath the one pressed reports the same, so before and after read at a glance down the page; Undo appears only on the row that was pressed.
  • The report clears on the next edit anywhere in the inspection (a verdict, a value, or a Single/Dual switch), and the actions return.
  • A scope with nothing left to mark renders inert rather than disappearing, keeping its place.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9883 (S18 — Mark a whole scope OK in one press); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S18; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S18-R6: “After the press the row will report what it covered, counted in its own unit — fields at inspection and section level, positions on a field — and will offer Undo”
  • S18-R7: “Every level beneath the one pressed will report the same, so before and after read at a glance down the page. Undo appears only on the row that was pressed”
  • S18-R8: “The report will clear on the next edit anywhere in the inspection — a verdict, a value, or a Single/Dual switch — and the actions return”
  • S18-R9: “A scope with nothing left to mark will render inert rather than disappearing. The pattern keeps its place”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
